title: Online Appendix: Advancing Greenhouse Gas Reporting with Blockchain and Life Cycle Assessment
description: Online appendix to "Advancing Greenhouse Gas Reporting with Blockchain and Life Cycle Assessment". It contains the Word version of the appendix (Online_Appendix.docx) and an interactive version (index.html, also viewable at https://lanxinjiang-stonybrook.github.io/gets-online-appendix/) that traces every figure in the paper's life-cycle emission report to its inputs, ledger records, transactions, and raw readings from the simulated year.
